(2) Close-up shots of human facial skin showing deep pitted acne scars are presented. The lighting is bright and direct to emphasize the skin's texture and the depth of the scars. (5) The doctor returns to the screen, continuing to explain while gesturing emphatically. Yellow text overlays highlight key phrases at the bottom of the frame. (6) The final frame displays the clinic logo, name in Chinese and English, contact phone number, and address on a stylized grey background with a feather graphic.
